title: It's Rising Up
lyrics: It's [E]rising up from coast to coast,
From north to south, and [C#m7]east to [B]west;
The [E]cry of hearts that love Your name,
Which with one voice we [C#m7]will pro[B]clai[E]m.
Can this be the new [C#m7]day of [B]praise?
A [E]heav'nly song that comes to birth,
That [A]all may come and [B]all may sing
And we have heard the lion's roar,
That speaks of heaven's love and power.
Is this the time, is this the call
That ushers in Your kingdom rule?
Oh let the cry to nations ring,
That all may come and all may sing
